coverageNotes: X07 gap-fill, 23 named companies, all placed in Bengaluru; none was already in the dataset under another name (checked every data/raw file by name and alias). BESCOM, BMRCL and KPTCL also appear in the X06 gap list (gap-chunks index 5); the merge should de-duplicate them. CLASSIFICATION CHANGES from the critic's labels, applied by the stated rules (origin = parent HQ; foreign-HQ'd multinational = MNC): Orkla India/MTR (Orkla ASA, Norway, majority), Tata Hitachi (Hitachi 60%), Eurofins Advinus (Eurofins, Luxembourg), Tavant (Santa Clara), Tredence (San Jose) and Sigmoid (San Francisco per TechCrunch and its contact page; another profile says Jersey City) are MNC/Foreign. This follows the precedent for United Spirits/Diageo and Toyota Kirloskar. NxtGen is STARTUP (venture-funded, founded 2012) and now trades as NxtGen Cloud Technologies Pvt Ltd. Shahi Exports is MID_SIZE only by elimination: it is unlisted, with 80,000+ workers in Karnataka. OMITTED or UNCONFIRMED: Shahi's Unit 29 at Kaggalipura was reported closing in Nov 2017 and is left out. Shahi has many more Bengaluru units (Indeed job postings name Bommasandra, Electronic City, Hulimavu, Madiwala and Sarjapur) but no addresses could be confirmed. MTR also has an older site at No. 4, 17th Cross, K.R. Road, BSK 2nd Stage (a 2024 Panjiva shipping record), left out as unconfirmed. The SSS Springs address '#139/2 Hosur Road, Koramangala' appears only in an old directory and is left out. Royal Orchid's other Bengaluru hotels (e.g. its Yelahanka resort and Whitefield suites) are not listed; only the registered office and the Royal Orchid Central sales office are. ACT's Bengaluru customer-service branches are recorded as the company's contact page lists them. BESCOM and KPTCL have dozens of division and sub-division offices in OSM (32 BESCOM POIs); only the corporate offices are recorded. PINS: several are locality, street or park centroids, not buildings, and geocodeSource and evidence say which: Shahi, Orkla, Jubilant Biosys, Alpha Design, IIFL Samasta, ACT branches, and the Bidadi/Jigani/Peenya/Bommasandra/Veerasandra estates. Eurofins Advinus and Sami-Sabinsa share the Peenya Industrial Area centroid. NxtGen's HQ and the Eurofins Advinus CDMO share the Bidadi centroid. BPL's Jigani plant shares the Jigani centroid with SSS Defence. HEADCOUNTS: only Jubilant Biosys' 400+ (company page) is recorded. The critic's figures for Tavant (~1,500), Sami-Sabinsa (~2,000) and Tredence (~3,500) could not be confirmed for Bengaluru and are left null. Jubilant Biosys' own site contradicts itself on HQ: the Bengaluru facility page says Bengaluru, the contact page says Noida.
